lead.description: the practice of drawing further samples from the observed sample and refitting a statistic on each draw

self_checks.title: Bootstrap variance
self_checks.prompt: For the sample 1, 2, 3, what is the variance of the bootstrap distribution of the sample mean?

self_checks.title: Jackknife bias
self_checks.prompt: For the divide-by-n variance of 1, 2, 3, what is the jackknife bias estimate?
self_checks.answer: The bias estimate is −1/3, and the corrected value is 1.

self_checks.title: Two-point bootstrap
self_checks.prompt: For the sample 4 and 9, what is the average of the four bootstrap means of size 2?

overview_sentence: [Resampling](articles/resampling-statistics.qmd) refits a statistic on draws from the observed sample, as the bootstrap and the jackknife do.
